task: Locate NWS public forecast zone editions in force 2021-10-17 to 2025-03-18 (read-only research)
bottom_line: No full-resolution NWS file for z_08se21, z_22mr22, z_07se22, z_13se22, z_08mr23 or z_05mr24 could be downloaded from this session. Wayback captures exist for four of them but every web.archive.org download was reset by the egress relay, and the CDX index returned 403 hostname_blocked. The IEM UGC API returns Montana zone sets for every valid date tested; these are simplified geometries. Per IEM, MT has 103 MTZ codes through 2022-09-13 12:00Z and 83 from 2022-09-13 18:00Z; the NWS change log dates the MT change 2022-09-07, which does not match.

recommendation: Use the IEM API (api/1/nws/ugcs.geojson?state=MT&valid=<UTC>) for Montana UGC codes by date. Its geometry is simplified (bbox within 0.014 deg of z_18mr25 for all 83 shared codes), so use it for code identity and coarse placement only, and confirm with the full-resolution NWS file before polygon-precise work. Before placing products issued 2022-09-07 to 2022-09-13, settle the Montana switch date: get z_07se22 and z_13se22 (or SCN 22-61) from the NWS, or from the Wayback captures once web.archive.org downloads work from this session.
caveats: MT switch date conflict: change log says z_07se22 (07 Sep 2022, SCN 22-61 MT) but IEM shows the 103-to-83 switch between 13 Sep 2022 12:00Z and 18:00Z; z_13se22 note says no zones deleted. Unresolved.
IEM geometries are simplified (per IEM OpenAPI text); not full resolution.
The 20 MT codes removed at the switch are MTZ008-MTZ015 and MTZ044-MTZ055 (listed in mt_switch.zones_removed_at_switch); the geometry of MTZ060 also changed.
web.archive.org: 5 snapshot downloads reset by the egress relay (ws_closed_mid_exchange, code 1006, 2-7 s); CDX index 403 hostname_blocked. Not retried further; not routed around.
Wayback availability API returned HTTP 429 (rate limit) on several calls; the successful answers are in the requests list.
z_18mr25 effective date is taken from the file name; the change log lists its entries without an Effective line.
IEM terms: 'public domain' and 'attribution appreciated' were not found; the IEM says free use for any lawful purpose and its site footer says All rights reserved.
The IEM geojson/ugcs.py URL is not a data endpoint (redirect to docs); its body was removed.
